product_overview: UNEFA Dashboard is a multi-role academic management system for organizing professional practice workflows at a university. It lets authenticated users manage students, tutors, institutions, pre-enrollments, enrollments, tracking, and culmination processes from role-based dashboards.
core_goals: Access the system securely and view a role-appropriate dashboard
Manage student records used in the professional practice workflow
Manage tutors and institutions involved in practice placements
Create and maintain pre-enrollments and enrollments for practice students
Track practice progress, visits, and related records
Review and process practice culmination records

features.name: Authentication and role-based access
features.description: Users sign in to access the platform and are taken to the dashboard or workspace appropriate to their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /signin -> Enter valid credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the main dashboard
Navigate to /signin -> Enter valid student credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the student dashboard
Navigate to /signin -> Enter valid tutor credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the tutor dashboard

features.name: Gestión de Estudiantes
features.description: Users create, review, update, search, and change the active status of student records.
user_flows: Navigate to /students -> Review the student list -> Create a new student record -> Save the record -> See the new student in the list
Navigate to /students -> Search for a student by name or ID number -> See matching results
Navigate to /students -> Open an existing student record for editing -> Update the student information -> Save the changes -> See the updated record in the list
Navigate to /students -> Change a student's status -> See the student marked as active or inactive

features.name: Gestión de Tutores
features.description: Users manage academic tutor records, including creation, editing, career assignment, and status changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /tutors -> Review the tutor list -> Create a new tutor record -> Assign careers to the tutor -> Save the record -> See the new tutor in the list
Navigate to /tutors -> Open an existing tutor record for editing -> Update the tutor information -> Save the changes -> See the updated tutor in the list
Navigate to /tutors -> Change a tutor's status -> See the tutor marked as active or inactive

features.name: Gestión de Instituciones
features.description: Users manage partner institutions and their responsible contacts.
user_flows: Navigate to /institutions -> Review the institution list -> Create a new institution record -> Add responsible contacts -> Save the record -> See the new institution in the list
Navigate to /institutions -> Open an existing institution record for editing -> Update the institution details -> Save the changes -> See the updated institution in the list
Navigate to /institutions -> Change an institution's status -> See the institution marked as active or inactive

features.name: Pre-inscripción
features.description: Users register students for the initial practice process and maintain active or inactive pre-enrollments.
user_flows: Navigate to /pre-enrollment -> Review active and inactive pre-enrollments -> Start a new pre-enrollment -> Fill in student data -> Select the career and academic period -> Choose the practice type -> Save the pre-enrollment -> See the new pre-enrollment in the list
Navigate to /pre-enrollment -> Open an existing pre-enrollment for editing -> Update the information -> Save the changes -> See the updated pre-enrollment in the list
Navigate to /pre-enrollment -> Change a pre-enrollment's status -> See the pre-enrollment marked as active or inactive

features.name: Inscripción
features.description: Users convert practice candidates into formal enrollments and manage active or inactive enrollment records.
user_flows: Navigate to /enrollment -> Review active and inactive enrollments -> Start a new enrollment -> Select the student, institution, and tutor -> Configure the period and practice type -> Save the enrollment -> See the new enrollment in the list
Navigate to /enrollment -> Open an existing enrollment for editing -> Update the enrollment details -> Save the changes -> See the updated enrollment in the list
Navigate to /enrollment -> Change an enrollment's status -> See the enrollment marked as active or inactive

features.name: Seguimiento de prácticas
features.description: Users maintain practice tracking records and review tracking statistics.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking -> Review the tracking list -> Create a new tracking record -> Save the record -> See the new tracking entry in the list
Navigate to /tracking -> Open an existing tracking record for editing -> Update the tracking information -> Save the changes -> See the updated tracking entry in the list
Navigate to /tracking -> Review the tracking statistics -> See summary information about tracking activity

features.name: Registro de visitas
features.description: Users record tutor visits related to student practice and document visit details.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking -> Start a new visit registration -> Select the student and practice -> Enter the visit date, visit type, and worked hours -> Describe the activities performed -> Add observations and recommendations -> Save the visit -> See the visit in the list
Navigate to /tracking -> Open an existing visit record for editing -> Update the visit details -> Save the changes -> See the updated visit record in the list

features.name: Culminación de prácticas
features.description: Users review completed practice records, approve or reject culmination, and generate certification documents.
user_flows: Navigate to /culmination -> Review the list of completed practices -> Approve a culmination record -> See the culmination marked as approved
Navigate to /culmination -> Review the list of completed practices -> Reject a culmination record -> See the culmination marked as rejected
Navigate to /culmination -> Open a completed practice record -> Generate the certification document -> See the certification available
